create_MiniHackFreezeWand_environment: create a MiniHackFreezeWand environment that generates an 8x8 level with a blessed wand of cold
create_MiniHackFreezeHorn_environment: create a MiniHackFreezeHorn environment that generates an 8x8 level with a blessed frost horn
create_MiniHackFreezeLava_environment: create a MiniHackFreezeLava environment with a lava river to freeze and a stair exit on the far bank
create_MiniHackFreezeRandom_environment: create a MiniHackFreezeRandom environment that randomly spawns either a wand of cold or a frost horn
register_MiniHack_freeze_environments: register all eight MiniHack freeze skill environments using the register function with entry points
